body:
The five-step restoring FP32 estimate candidate now passes the complete retained source/module profile at source `4498cc41168ad29fc4c111819a4cb7ccaa54a8bf`. The original 35-module profile has 17 changed and 18 unchanged modules; 40 main arrays have 17 changed and 23 unchanged, both owner arrays remain equal, and all seven program tables, public/shared layouts, execution modes and ordered barriers retain their joins. All 13 named Divide graphs preserve the complete prefix, fallback and common Round with only the original fallback UDiv. All four inlined camera modules pass the typed guard/product/borrow/five-step/control checks at both proposal sites. Complete inlined normalization/Round/fallback additionally relies on the exact frozen source and original O1; this is not an independent reconstruction of every inlined operation.

Two earlier stops remain preserved as failures: the [missing owner metadata stop](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4ea1edd7f5de358145c99f579e79a052073e045d/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-profile-owner-stop) completed the cheap stock child but failed its wrapper, and the [RSS stop](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/45a83f5c2f6b019dab8f582dde5b452f5eb037f8/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-profile-reader-rss-stop) retained successful compilation/policy/validation of all 90 candidate products while its reader exceeded 4 GiB. Neither failed owner was promoted. The old per-block full dominator sets have quadratic storage; that source defect is consistent with the RSS stop, without a captured earlier stack/PC claim.

The separate reader-only finisher replaced dominance storage with exact removed-node reachability for entry-reachable queries. It reused immutable compiler products without repeating stock staging, Slang, SSA, policy, assembly or validation. One root-owned read and separate review passed: 209.545638 s, peak sampled RSS 92,692 KiB, unchanged 300 s / 4 GiB / 2 GiB reserve. All 293 frozen records, 834 actual input records and 17 sealed outputs matched; all three observed process births were freshly absent. It produced 16 missing disassemblies and reused 54 saved pairs, including the partial camera dump only after a full fresh alpha comparison. Independent review also matched all 17 changed instruction streams (238,209 instructions).

[Accepted profile, source, ownership and independent review](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b207cd8a781eaef4ad4683e52245948c8ca152b0/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-profile-reader-recovery) are pushed under `evidence/issue-44-fp32-estimate-restoring-profile-reader-recovery`; manifest SHA256 `d24b803c4414585fcf3598061fe82a9ab124c41666dcce1307c571e00f19e76e`. The completed temporary profile workspace has been retired after complete Git/local verification. The previously reported primitive arithmetic pass remains separate.

The original eight integrated controls and both complete output readers are next; their source preparation reuses matching inputs and freshly compiles both candidate-header consumers. The original 20+2 benefit gates remain required afterward. No integrated correctness, hit rate, rendering speed, adoption, full scientific/runtime qualification or release readiness is claimed. Canonical source remains clean and pushed on `development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15`; PR62 remains draft and unmerged.
scope: Coherent full-profile milestone and both preceding failures; integrated/benefit/qualification remain future. Operational receipt outside future freeze/action/runtime closure.
